title: 通过级联线性特征检测和控制谄媚行为
summary: 提出一种迭代数据生成管道，通过级联线性特征分离模型行为，有效检测和引导语言模型远离谄媚行为。该方法优于基线，计算需求更低，可解释性更强。
summary_en: Presents an iterative data generation pipeline that isolates cascading linear features to detect and steer language models away from sycophancy, outperforming baselines with lower computational demand and better interpretability.
